dedupe_keys.name: metropt2 a benchmark dataset for predictive maintenance

description: Bruno Veloso and colleagues publish MetroPT2 observations from an air-production unit on Porto metro trains. The description gives a recording period of 28 April to 28 July 2022 at one hertz, including pressure, motor current, oil temperature, control signals and position information. Two CSV files are openly available under CC BY 4.0. The record reports about 7.12 million instances and supplies operator-reported air-leak and oil-leak intervals, while individual observations are otherwise unlabelled. These signals can calibrate anomaly detection and maintenance or remaining-life simulations. The metadata mention both 21 attributes and 16 signals; the exact column interpretation remains unknown without inspecting the files. Two reported failure intervals do not establish broad failure coverage. No related catalogue record explicitly covers MetroPT2. The large CSV files were not downloaded.
